name: Cucumberleaf Sunflower
desc: Cucumberleaf Sunflower (Helianthus debilis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 38 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Helianthus debilis is a species of sunflower known by the common names cucumberleaf sunflower, beach sunflower, weak sunflower, East Florida beach sunflower, and East Coast dune sunflower.
